title: Discount positions loop (guide fig. 2, DIPO loop)
summary: Drill-down of "Discount role": model selection, per-position matrix match, scale limit and value pick, then relation rules and the net result. Mapped from field guide inputs/dsp-price-calculation.html (sha256:d260ad4216e3); every node is tagged confirmed / design-only / conflicting / code-only against code. Conceptual stages, decisions and data transformations only; not a call stack or observed runtime behaviour.

Price Discount Calculation: OGDIPO by OCUSMA.DISY (<= 8 DIPO), allocated discount number (Optimera/Flisekompaniet position 4 for agreement prices), OGDMTX 10 template field sets (PC11..PC91, PC01 = 10) with PREX, LIMT <= requested quantity, SGGB 22/32 + SGGC + SGGU scale limit, DITP/DIBE/DIRE calculation, DDSU presentation (per line vs order total).

uncertainties: Guide: scale limit from the ordered quantity (SGGB 22, in SGGU unit) or line value (SGGB 32), SGGC graduated/best. Code has no quantity: the regular price uses limit 0 and each LIMT > 0 becomes a volume step; code comment says only the SGGB 22/SGGC 2 equivalent without unit conversion is provided; SGGB 32 is absent.
Guide: priority 1 first, first matching row wins. Code orders by LIMT before priority, so a lower-priority row with a higher qualifying limit wins.
